policy: Claims about hidden structure are tracked separately from evidence. Publication status and method lineage affect claim credibility but do not by themselves prove or disprove a specific geometry.

claims.title: SAR Doppler / micro-motion tomography method lineage used in pyramid hidden-structure claims
claims.publisher_reason_summary: Publisher investigation reported serious methodological flaws and statistical errors undermining the scientific conclusions. Authors disagreed with the retraction.
claims.model_policy: No GIZA geometry may be promoted from this method lineage without independent, non-retracted validation and raw-data reproducibility.

claims.title: Large deep subsurface Khafre geometry currently represented in GIZA
claims.model_policy: Remain UNVERIFIED. Forward simulations are conditional consequences only. Independent survey/geophysics evidence required for promotion.
